_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 73 recent 12h windows showing a ±2+ point move, HOLD is the statistically honest call — the coil has not broken and neither brain provides a confirmed trigger signal.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction; narrative implies upward resolution via August analog but does not explicitly call direction, creating a lean disagreement
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed drops below 25 with VIX spiking above 70 and funding collapsing below 35 (Panic shift) OR ETF flows surge above 40 with btc_momentum_30d above 60 and stablecoin_growth above 55 (Disbelief/Hope shift)
next_move.invalidated_if: Score remains within ±2 points for another 7+ days without a catalyst — extended coil stagnation would reduce edge to zero and require signal downgrade to HOLD
